Sales Manager / Sales Marketer Job at Prestigious Consulting




        
    

        
        Prestigious Consulting is a professional HR consultancy firm. We focus on improving organizational performance through strategic people & process management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales Manager / Sales Marketer

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking an experienced Sales Marketer/Sales Manager to conduct marketing and sales activities across Lagos, generate new business, build strong customer relationships, and drive sales of building materials.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Conduct sales and marketing activities within Lagos.
	Identify and develop new customers and business opportunities.
	Promote and sell building materials to prospective and existing customers.
	Generate leads and convert prospects into paying customers.
	Build and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, dealers, and other industry stakeholders.
	Follow up on leads, enquiries, quotations, and sales opportunities.
	Achieve assigned sales targets.
	Conduct market visits and identify new market opportunities.
	Monitor market trends and competitor activities.
	Prepare regular sales and marketing reports.


Requirements


	Proven experience in building materials sales.
	Good knowledge of the Lagos building materials market.
	Strong sales, negotiation, communication, and networking skills.
	Proven ability to generate leads and close sales.
	Target-driven, proactive, and results-oriented.
	Ability to conduct field marketing activities across Lagos.
	Applicants must live on Lagos Island or its environs.
	Previous experience in a sales management role is an added advantage.


Compensation


	N200,000 monthly salary
	Sales commission.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using "Application – Sales Marketer/Sales Manager" as the subject of the mail.

Refinery Lead Job at Westfield Consulting




        
    

        
        Westfield Consulting - Our client in the Oil & Gas space is recruiting qualified and passionate candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Refinery Lead
Job Location: Koko, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Refinery Lead will oversee refinery operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and environmentally compliant processing of petroleum products.
	The role requires strong leadership, technical expertise, and the ability to integrate refinery activities with the company’s broader services in waste management, pollution control, and petroleum product supply.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Refinery Operations: Direct daily refinery processes including crude oil distillation, product blending, and quality assurance.
	Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to Nigerian regulatory standards, environmental laws, and international best practices.
	Team Leadership: Supervise engineers, technicians, and operators; provide training and mentorship.
	Environmental Management: Collaborate with the environmental consultancy unit to minimize emissions, manage waste, and implement pollution control measures.
	Supply Chain Coordination: Work with the petroleum marketing and haulage divisions to guarantee timely product distribution.
	Marine & Logistics Integration: Align refinery output with marine transport services for domestic and international supply.
	Performance Monitoring: Track KPIs such as throughput, yield, downtime, and cost efficiency.
	Innovation & Sustainability: Drive adoption of cleaner technologies and sustainable refinery practices.


Key Requirements


	Degree in Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering or related field (Master’s preferred).
	Minimum of 10 years of experience in refinery operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian oil & gas regulations and international refinery standards.
	Proven track record in environmental compliance and waste management integration.
	Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.


Competencies:


	Strategic Thinking.
	Operational Excellence.
	Health, Safety & Environment (HSE).
	Stakeholder Management.
	Technical Expertise.


Salary
N1,000,000 – N1,400,000 per month (However, the salary can be negotiated upward depending on the candidate’s experience).

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their current CV to: [email protected] with [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Diagnose batteries, BMS faults, chargers, controllers, motors, sensors, connectors and other electrical/electromechanical components.
	Conduct voltage, current, continuity, charging, thermal and component performance tests.

	Document test results, findings, photographs and repair recommendations.
	Support decisions on whether components should be repaired, reused, quarantined, returned under warranty or scrapped.
	Assist with testing and validation of new EV kits and components before deployment.
	Support hardware R&D, battery-pack improvements, controller/motor testing and wiring/harness improvements.
	Identify recurring technical faults and provide recommendations to improve reliability and conversion quality.
	Follow strict safety procedures when working with lithium batteries and electrical systems.
	Prepare clear technical reports and provide practical guidance to technicians.

	HND, BSc or strong technical diploma in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Physics, Electronics or a related field.
	1–3+ years of practical experience in electronics diagnosis, battery systems, EV systems, mechatronics, automotive electrical systems, laboratory testing or technical R&D.
	Good knowledge of batteries and electrical systems.
	Understanding of BMS, motors, controllers, sensors, power electronics, wiring harnesses and charging systems is an advantage.
	Ability to use tools such as multimeters, clamp meters, bench power supplies, soldering/rework tools and diagnostic equipment.
	Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
	Ability to prepare clear technical reports.

	Hands-on and technically minded

	Safety-conscious

title: Job Openings at Oilserv Limited
content:
Oilserv Limited is a leading provider of integrated engineering, procurement, construction, installation & commissioning (EPCIC) services and complementary solutions across the asset and program life cycle within the onshore, offshore and subsea market segments of the oil and gas sector. Oilserv Limited was incorporated in 1992 and commenced operations in 1995.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Learning & Development Specialist 

Job Location: Rivers

Job Summary
     

            
    




	To support the Head Human Resources in the effective delivery of the overall L&D and Recruitment strategy.
	The post holder will identify development needs, design, create and deliver solutions across the organisation at every level, including online learning.
	Responsible for setting clear points of evaluation and able to demonstrate the degree of success achieved for all L&D interventions.


Job Details
Training scheduling and coordination:


	Consult and partner with line managers/heads of department to incorporate operational/functional requirements and implement training needs assessments (TNA). 
	Develop and manage evaluation methods and reporting metrics to support the measurement of programme effectiveness.
	Build and sustain relationships with training providers and accreditation bodies to deliver effective training activities to the business. 
	Drive employee/self-paced learning on the Learning Management System (LMS) and track usage to ensure value 
	Monitor training & development costs and expenses to assist in budget preparation 
	To design needed trainings and other learning projects with the performance objectives in mind 
	Execute/facilitate needed training and other learning projects 
	Maintain effective relationship with ITF on annual training plans and ensure full annual reimbursements 
	Evaluating training outcomes and generating weekly and monthly L&D reports 
	Coordinating performance management procedure across business units 
	Implement routine performance audits across the business units  
	Ensure good personal adherence to Health, Safety, Security and Environmental practice is maintained and exhibited at all times 
	Perform other tasks as assigned by the Head of Human Resources.


Requirements


	BSc / HND in Management or Social Science or any related discipline from a reputable University/ Polytechnic
	Minimum of Five (5) years of cumulative cognate experience in an HR/Learning & Development role 
	CIPMN, SHRM, CIPD, CIPM
	Knowledge of Performance Management 
	Experience in the oil and gas industry is an added advantage.
	Ability to communicate at all levels
	Excellent organizational/time management skills
	Working knowledge of an Applicants Tracking System (ATS) or SAP HR 
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suites 
	Knowledge of Advanced interviewing techniques 
	Familiar with a wide variety of sourcing avenues – especially for top Engineering/Project Mgt talent.


Application Closing Date: 30th September, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

2.) Client Relations Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	Responsible for managing and growing commercial relationships with Umu-Gas CNG and NGL offtake customers, distributors, and industrial clients.
	The role serves as the primary commercial point of contact for clients, ensuring contract compliance, service reliability, and high levels of customer satisfaction, while identifying opportunities to expand the client base and strengthen revenue performance ahead of and following first gas.


Job Details


	Serve as the primary commercial contact for existing and prospective CNG and NGL offtake clients
	Negotiate, review, and manage offtake agreements, supply contracts, and service level agreements in coordination with Legal and Commercial functions
	Onboard new clients, including credit vetting, contract execution, and delivery setup coordination with Logistics
	Monitor contract performance and delivery schedules, working closely with the Logistics Manager to resolve supply or scheduling issues
	Investigate and resolve client billing queries, service complaints, and commercial disputes in a timely and professional manner
	Develop and maintain a client relationship management (CRM) system, ensuring accurate records of contracts, communications, and account history
	Track and report on client satisfaction, contract renewals, revenue performance, and key account metrics to the Commercials and Business Development Manager
